name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover storm-damaged drywall replacement?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover storm-damaged drywall replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard homeowner's insurance policies cover storm-related damage, including drywall replacement, as long as the damage was sudden and accidental. This typically includes damage from wind, hail, or direct rain intrusion caused by a covered peril. However, policies often exclude damage from floods or gradual leaks. It's essential to review your specific policy, understand your deductible, and contact your insurance provider promptly to file a claim and confirm coverage details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance usually covers sudden storm-related drywall damage but check your specific policy for exclusions like floods.
